topic: Frequency chart data source and discrepancies
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the methodology for calculating a frequency chart, specifically whether it should use full vendor datasets or only trusted data. It was clarified that while some parties suggested using unique users (uniques) from the trusted sample, [me] stated that the calculation is based on sessions and not aggregates or models.

Regarding discrepancies reported by Latvia, the core issue is a mismatch in expected values—whether the comparison should be between session counts or unique user counts. The chart bar needs to be adjusted across all vendors.
decisions: The frequency chart must account for the discrepancy across all vendors.
A fix for the chart bar was promised for early next week.
action_items: Create a task (JCDEC-676) regarding the chart adjustment.
Confirm if trusted vendors are included for unique user counts for Wonderful Copenhagen.
